hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Wall thickness checks on chokes, tees, and elbows carrying proppant returns.

name: Adjustable choke
function: The choke whose opening is set by a stem and handwheel, with an indicator reading in 64ths of an inch, used to bring the well on and change rate in steps.

tabs.overview: A needle and seat; the stem screws in and out; erosion-resistant trim. Used for the fine control early in flowback, then swapped for a positive bean once the rate settles.
tabs.safety: Erosion of the needle and seat with sand; the indicator drifts as the trim wears.
tabs.evidence: Public flowback and well testing overview (S25), field practice (S9).
